evidence_scope: lockbox_window (sig_date <= 2023-12-22, 228 months). Post-lockbox 28 months reported as OOS-only (not discovery evidence).
verdict_rationale: ACCRUAL multi-axis composite FAILS 0/5 graduation gates within the lockbox window. (1) LOCKBOX composite mean rank-IC = -0.0045 (NEGATIVE), ICIR -0.063, harvey-t(rank-IC) -0.516. The marginally-positive +0.0014 seen on the full sample came ENTIRELY from post-lockbox months (OOS IC +0.0496) — i.e. positive signal exists ONLY past the cutoff, which is exactly the selection contamination the lockbox prevents. (2) composite_beats_single=FALSE: composite ICIR -0.063 << best-single AC22 ICIR 0.230 (QMJ kill criterion 합성<단일이면 무의미). (3) DSR 0.053 << 0.50 (beta-neutral alpha residual). (4) portfolio-alpha t 1.372 (NS, monthly alpha 0.35%). (5) realized_beta 1.094 — top25 EW basket is purely market-like, no defensive/orthogonal return structure. (6) return_cor vs STR_1715 = 0.803 despite signal cor -0.066 (BAB structural problem: signal orthogonal, returns not). Even the sole signal carrier AC22 (harvey-t 1.89 in lockbox) fails 3.0. Confirms AX-003/AX-004: KR single-family long-only fails; multi-axis composite did NOT rescue.
